channel.title: The Grant Desk - next 30 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: next 30 days, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: Mozilla Data Collective: Lost in Transcription ASR Challenge
item.description: Mozilla Data Collective (Mozilla Foundation) · deadline 02 Oct 2026 · USD 20,000 total in prizes across three language tracks (per track: USD 4,000 for first place and USD 2,000 for second, plus a bonus award for the lowest average word error rate across all three tracks). No entry fee.

item.title: Delfina Foundation x Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation: Open Call for Artists from Portugal and Portuguese-Speaking African Nations (London residency)
item.description: Delfina Foundation, in partnership with the Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation (UK Branch) · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · Twelve-week fully funded residency: a return economy-class flight, airport transfers in the UK, reimbursement of visa fees if required, a living allowance of GBP 40 per day, a materials budget of GBP 1,200, a travel pass for London's public transport network, and a single bedroom with a desk at Delfina Foundation, a house hosting up to eight residents with shared bathrooms, laundry rooms, kitchen, library and dining room. No application fee.

item.title: Peripheral Acts Edition 2: Leaning Out (UAE balcony residency)
item.description: Peripheral Acts, conceptualised and hosted by Shazia Salam and Priyanka Mehra · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · AED 1,000 artist commission fee plus AED 1,500 production budget per artist. Three artists commissioned. No application fee.

item.title: Institute for Law & AI: Winter Research Fellowship EU Law 2027 (Cambridge, UK)
item.description: Institute for Law & AI (LawAI) · deadline 12 Oct 2026 · GBP 1,000 weekly stipend for the 10-week fellowship (GBP 10,000 total), plus a GBP 7,000 relocation and housing payment. No application fee.

item.title: Ernest Albert Invitational 2027: Reflective Residency at Cas-co x Kunsthal Mechelen
item.description: Cas-co, Leuven and Kunsthal Mechelen · deadline 14 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,480 total including VAT: an artist fee of EUR 1,100 per month, a transportation allowance of EUR 120 per month, and a one-time production budget of EUR 600. No application fee.

item.title: AAPI Fund: Creative Catalyst Fellowship 2027 (theme Belonging)
item.description: AAPI Civic Engagement Fund · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to eight artists each receive USD 30,000 to produce new work. Also covered: the two-day Fellows retreat (travel and accommodation paid by the AAPI Fund), an accomplished communications consultant, digital advertising, community introductions, exhibition placement support and replica development (posters, books, calendars) promoting the finished work. No application fee.

item.title: Tilting Axis Fellowship 2027 for Caribbean-Based Practitioners (with Nieuwe Instituut)
item.description: Tilting Axis, with Nieuwe Instituut, Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam, Fresh Milk (Barbados), RAA! (Aruba) and Instituto Buena Bista (Curacao) · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 2,500 stipend per fellow, plus up to EUR 1,000 travel budget for research-related movement and full coverage of airfare and Netherlands programming during the visit. No application fee.

item.title: La Nueva Fabrica Residency 2027-2028 (Antigua, Guatemala)
item.description: La Nueva Fabrica (LNF) · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · USD 2,000 stipend, plus free housing in an equipped on-site house, airport transfers, curatorial and logistical support, and access to community programming. Five residents selected annually. No application fee.

item.title: Next Nature: Heaven's Hospital Open Call (commissions on the future of care)
item.description: Heaven's Hospital / Next Nature Museum · deadline 20 Oct 2026 · Three selected projects each receive a budget of EUR 15,000 for the development of a first prototype or artistic intervention. Selected participants become Heaven's Hospital Fellows and join an international network of designers, researchers, care professionals and artists. No application fee stated.

item.title: Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Residency Jatiwangi art Factory 2027 (Indonesia)
item.description: Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) in collaboration with Jatiwangi art Factory, Indonesia · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · EUR 4,500 subsidy for a two-month residency, paid by the Creative Industries Fund NL. Accommodation at Jatiwangi art Factory is provided: a small private container house furnished with two single beds and a bathroom/toilet. No application fee.

item.title: Anima 2027: Brussels International Animation Film Festival Submissions
item.description: Anima, Brussels International Animation Film Festival · deadline 02 Oct 2026 · Free to submit until 2 October 2026. Winners in the main competition categories receive cash prizes plus an Anima trophy (the 2027 prize list is published in late January 2027). The festival is an Academy Award and BAFTA qualifying festival for eligible films.

item.title: Braunschweig Projects 2027/28: Artistic Fellowships at HBK Braunschweig (Fine Arts and Sound Art)
item.description: Braunschweig University of Art (HBK Braunschweig), on behalf of the State of Lower Saxony · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · Stipend of EUR 1,600 per month for 12 months, plus a rent-free one-person studio apartment in Braunschweig (fellows pay EUR 250 per month towards incidental living costs) and an allowance for project and travel costs. 7 fellowships: 5 in fine arts and 2 in sound art. No application fee.

item.title: Kaboom Animation Festival 2027: Call for Entries
item.description: Kaboom Animation Festival · deadline 05 Oct 2026 · No entry fee for submitting to Kaboom's competitions. Competition awards are given across categories (amounts not published in the call); the festival is known for an open, experimental definition of animation.

item.title: Dublin City Council: Visual Arts Exhibition Commission for Ballyfermot Library (curated by IMMA)
item.description: Dublin City Council Creative Hubs programme, delivered by The Ark, curated by IMMA (Irish Museum of Modern Art) · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 10,000 commission award for research and delivery of commissioned works for the exhibition. Technical support for installation is provided by IMMA, and the artist is supported by Arts Office and Library staff during the research phase. No application fee.

item.title: Humanity AI: Open Call for Proposals 2026
item.description: Humanity AI (coalition of 10 philanthropies) · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · USD 10 million total pool, grants of USD 75,000 to 1,000,000 across three tiers: Tier 1 USD 75,000-150,000; Tier 2 USD 150,000-500,000; Tier 3 USD 500,000-1,000,000. Grants run up to three years. No application fee.

item.title: Brooks International Fellowship Programme 2027 (Tate Britain x Delfina Foundation)
item.description: Tate, in collaboration with Delfina Foundation · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · Fully funded 6-month fellowship: living allowance bursary of GBP 40 per day, single bedroom at Delfina Foundation (house of up to 8 residents with shared facilities), return economy flight, UK airport transfers, visa fee reimbursement with visa support, London Underground and bus travel pass, a research resource allowance, and travel to other Tate galleries (Tate Modern, Liverpool, St Ives) and other UK and European cultural institutions. Two fellowships available. No application fee.

item.title: Stroom Den Haag: PRO Art Projects
item.description: Stroom Den Haag · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 per project, up to EUR 20,000 per applicant per calendar year. Requests above EUR 5,000 require at least 30 percent co-financing of the total budget from third parties. Artist fees, production and communication costs are eligible; Stroom endorses the kunstenaarshonorarium.nl fee guideline. No application fee.

item.title: Stroom Den Haag: PRO Art Program
item.description: Stroom Den Haag · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 per application, up to EUR 20,000 per applicant per calendar year. Requests above EUR 5,000 require at least 30 percent co-financing of the total budget from third parties. Compliance with the kunstenaarshonorarium.nl artist fee guideline is part of the assessment. No application fee.

item.title: Stroom Den Haag: PRO Research
item.description: Stroom Den Haag · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 5,000 per research project, up to EUR 20,000 per applicant per calendar year. Amounts exclude VAT and grants are only awarded on demonstrable financial need. No application fee.

item.title: First Flights Short Film Fund (Autumn 2026 Round)
item.description: First Flights Media Limited, with Kodak and Periscope · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Up to GBP 7,000 / USD 10,000 cash toward production; plus two Kodak awards of 5 x 400ft rolls of 16mm stock with full processing, and one USD 10,000 Periscope post-production package

item.title: Making Space Residency 2027 for Netherlands-Based Practitioners (Guangzhou)
item.description: Making Space, in partnership with the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in China · deadline 03 Oct 2026 · EUR 2,700 travel and artist fee subsidy (fixed per application; duos or collectives share it), plus accommodation in Guangzhou and shared studio space

item.title: Welcome to my Homepage: Online Net Art Residency, Oulu Edition
item.description: The Museum of Human Achievement (MoHA), Austin, TX, with Oulu UNESCO City of Media Arts, Oulu Urban Culture and Frozen People · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 500 stipend, plus a user-friendly web builder (mmm.page), virtual studio visits and mentor conversations, promotion, a year-round showcase at welcometomyhomepage.net and a kiosk at the Austin Public Library's Innovate Lab, and in-person pop-up exhibitions at the Frozen People Festival in Oulu and at MoHA in Austin (Austin installation handled by the organisers; no resident travel funds to Austin). Free to apply.

item.title: MATS Residency Program: 6-24 Month Funded AI Safety Research (Winter 2027 intake)
item.description: MATS (ML Alignment and Theory Scholars) · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 155,000 to 285,000 per year gross (set by location, seniority, and experience), plus medical/dental/vision/life insurance, retirement plan, paid time off, conference funding, catered meals, and up to USD 25,000 relocation support. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute AI Nodes RFP, Track I: Local Compute
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Typically $30,000 to $100,000 per grant (larger possible for the right project), plus private local compute and workspace at the San Francisco or Berlin AI Nodes. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute AI Nodes RFP, Track II: Coordination and Accountability
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Typically $30,000 to $100,000 per grant, with smaller amounts for the Human Empowerment and AI Insurance & Open Governance focus areas; plus private local compute and workspace at the San Francisco or Berlin AI Nodes. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute AI Nodes RFP, Track III: AI-First Science (Bio, Neuro, Nano)
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Typically $30,000 to $100,000 per grant, with higher amounts for this track than the Human Empowerment and AI Insurance areas (larger possible for the right project); plus private local compute and workspace at the San Francisco or Berlin AI Nodes. No application fee.

item.title: American-Scandinavian Foundation: Fellowships for Americans in the Nordic Countries 2027-28
item.description: American-Scandinavian Foundation · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Long-term fellowships of up to USD 23,000 for 4 to 12 months; short-term grants of up to USD 5,000 for 1 to 3 months. In 2026, 31 American Fellows received over USD 277,390 in total funding. Awards are given in all fields, including creative arts projects.

item.title: Frameline Completion Fund 2027
item.description: Frameline · deadline 09 Oct 2026 · Grants of up to USD 5,000, with a standard range of USD 1,000 to 5,000; the jury can recommend amounts above or below that range. No application fee.

item.title: SAT: Research-Creation Residency Program in Arts and Technologies 2026-28 (Montreal)
item.description: Societe des arts technologiques (SAT) · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · CAD 10,000 grant per selected project, for individual artists and collectives alike. Also included: access to SAT workspaces during the residency periods, access to equipment and software resources subject to availability, mentoring and training activities (on site and remote), creative and technical support from the SAT teams, and documentation and archiving of the work. Travel, meals and accommodation beyond the grant are NOT covered. No application fee.

item.title: Netherlands Film Production Incentive (October 2026 round)
item.description: Netherlands Film Fund (Nederlands Filmfonds) · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · Cash rebate of up to 35 percent of qualifying Dutch production costs, capped at EUR 3 million per year per applicant production company. The annual budget is EUR 20 million divided across four rounds at roughly EUR 5 million per round, with an extra EUR 3 million in the first round. No application fee.

item.title: Netherlands Film Production Incentive: High-End Series (October 2026 round)
item.description: Netherlands Film Fund (Nederlands Filmfonds) · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · Cash rebate of up to 35 percent of qualifying Dutch production costs, capped at EUR 3 million per project per year per applicant production company. The 2026 annual budget is EUR 9.5 million across three rounds, plus an additional EUR 0.4 million in the first round carried over from 2025. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute: AI for Science & Safety Nodes RFP
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Typically $30,000 to $100,000 per grant, with smaller amounts for the Human Empowerment and AI Insurance & Open Governance focus areas and higher amounts for the rest (larger possible for the right project), plus private local compute and workspace at the San Francisco or Berlin AI Nodes. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Teatri Riflessi 2027: Short Performance Competition (12th edition)
    https://www.iterculture.eu/en/teatri-riflessi/tr2027/tr12/
    IterCulture APS · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Gross performance fee of EUR 500 to EUR 1,100 (VAT included) per selected short performance, scaled by the number of performers on stage, plus a possible travel contribution of up to EUR 250 subject to available funding, place of origin, cast size and absence of external touring grants. At least 10 performances are selected. Competition prizes: Best Performance EUR 1,200; Best Dramaturgy, Best Direction, Best Performer and the Scholars' and Critics' Award EUR 500 each; 'Valentina Nicosia' Fund EUR 500; 'Sandra Bressan' research fund EUR 1,800; Youth Jury Award EUR 300; plus non-cash awards (Audience Special Mention, Companies' Choice, Technical Crew). Panel members and Teatri Riflessi Network partners may also award special prizes in the form of artist residencies and touring opportunities. Application is free; selected companies pay a EUR 50 deposit that is fully refunded after the festival.
  • Design Trust Seed, Feature & Impact Grants (Hong Kong / Greater Bay Area)
    https://designtrust.hk/grants/dtgrants/
    Design Trust · deadline 20 Oct 2026 · Seed Grant: HKD 50,000. Feature Grant: capped at HKD 300,000, awarded annually upon special consideration. Impact Grant: case-by-case, for former grantees. Full or partial funding on a case-by-case basis. Free to apply.

item.title: 4 new grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Gemeente Den Haag: Arts and Culture Projects Category B (autumn 2026 round)
    https://www.denhaag.nl/nl/subsidies/subsidies-cultuur-en-evenementen/subsidie-kunst-en-cultuurprojecten-aanvragen/
    Gemeente Den Haag (Municipality of The Hague) · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 10,000 to 30,000 per application. The municipal culture-budget contribution may not exceed 30 percent of the total project budget, so at least 70 percent co-financing is required. Annual ceiling for the strand is EUR 600,000. No application fee.
  • Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Residency Videotage 2027 (Hong Kong)
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/open-call-videotage
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) in collaboration with Videotage, Hong Kong · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 for a two-month residency or EUR 6,500 for a three-month residency, paid by the Creative Industries Fund NL to cover travel, insurance, living expenses, compensation for time invested, and material and transport costs. Accommodation, use of the studio space and facilitation by Videotage are covered directly by the Fund on top of this. No application fee.
  • Stichting NORMA: NORMA Fonds Project Grant (round 4, 2026)
    https://www.stichtingnorma.nl/norma-fonds/aanvragen/
    Stichting NORMA (collecting society for performing artists) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 per project. Total project budget may not exceed EUR 150,000 and the applicant organisation's annual budget may not exceed EUR 500,000. At least 25 percent of the project budget must come from audience or box-office revenue. Performer fees must meet the 2026 wage norms of EUR 139 per rehearsal and EUR 340 per performance. No application fee.
  • Cultuurloket DigitALL: Implementation Contribution (Implementatiebijdrage, 2026)
    https://cultuurloketdigitall.nl/implementatiebijdrage/
    Cultuurloket DigitALL · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Up to EUR 30,000. Covers technical modification, system integration, production and deployment costs. Hardware purchase alone is ineligible unless clearly essential to the public experience. No stated co-financing percentage. No application fee.

item.title: 4 new grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Slamdance Film Festival 2027: DIG (Digital, Interactive and Gaming)
    https://slamdance.com/festival-submit/
    Slamdance · deadline 06 Oct 2026 · Festival exhibition at Slamdance in Los Angeles. DIG welcomes interactive documentaries, VR/AR, experiential installations, and genre-bending games. Entry fees: USD 60 regular, USD 70 late, USD 90 extended/final.
  • Architecture Kick Start Grant Scheme
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/architecture-kick-start-grant-scheme
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) · deadline 07 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 total project budget including co-financing. Round budget EUR 167,000. Maximum 35 applications per period, ordered by random draw. No application fee.
  • Glasgow Short Film Festival 2027 (20th edition)
    https://glasgowshort.org/submissions/
    Glasgow Short Film Festival · deadline 27 Oct 2026 · Selection for GSFF including the Bill Douglas Award for International Short Film. Entry fees: GBP 10 earlybird, GBP 14 regular, GBP 18 late (slightly higher via FilmFreeway).
  • Science & Technology Policy Fellowships, 2027-28 Class
    https://www.aaas.org/programs/science-technology-policy-fellowships
    American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Stipend depending on experience and placement, roughly USD 85,000 to 140,000; the dedicated AI legislative branch cohort is paid at GS-12 Step 10 on the DC locality scale. Includes health insurance, a travel and professional development allowance, and relocation support for some placements. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 29 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Open Interval: An Artist-Scientist Exploration of Turbulence
    https://www.simonsfoundation.org/2026/06/01/coming-soon-open-interval-an-artist-scientist-exploration-of-turbulence/
    Simons Foundation · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · USD 30,000 per awarded trio

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 18 May 2026
item.description:
• Toronto Arts Council: Media Artists Program - Creation 2026
    https://torontoartscouncil.org/grants/media-artists-program-creation/
    Toronto Arts Council · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to $15,000 (CAD) per artist for media-arts creation. No application fee.

item.title: 3 new grants - week of 11 May 2026
item.description:
• McGraw Fellowship for Business Journalism - Fall 2026 cycle
    https://www.mcgrawcenter.org/the-harold-w-mcgraw-jr-business-journalism-fellowships/
    Harold W. McGraw, Jr. Center for Business Journalism (Newmark Graduate School of Journalism, CUNY) · deadline 12 Oct 2026 · Up to USD 15,000 per fellowship, plus editorial supervision and placement assistance. No application fee.
  • NEH: Public Humanities Projects (2026-27 deadlines)
    https://www.neh.gov/grants/public/public-humanities-projects
    National Endowment for the Humanities (NEH) · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Planning grants up to USD 75,000; Implementation grants up to USD 1,000,000 (most awards substantially smaller). Two upcoming deadlines: 15 October 2026 and 9 December 2026.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Art Media Grant (October 2026 round)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/art-media/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to 70% of eligible expenses. Round budget: €229,000. Two structures: fixed grant of €2,480 per month for 1-6 month work periods, OR a flexible grant of up to 12 months with the amount determined by project plan and budget.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 27 Apr 2026
item.description:
• International Vouchers
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/international-vouchers
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) · deadline 27 Oct 2026 · Up to €1,500 within Europe (zone 1) / up to €2,500 outside Europe (zone 2)
